permissions.desc: Connects to the Glimpse backend to load message digests and sources, send replies, request reply drafts, mark messages read, and upload voice recordings for transcription.
permissions.name: network

permissions.desc: Uses the microphone built into the glasses to record short voice replies (up to 30 seconds). Recordings are sent to the Glimpse backend for transcription and are never captured outside an explicit recording action.
permissions.name: g2-microphone
